data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Estimated shipping times were not…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/650a5d6e8f0f51131500991d)
Estimated shipping times were not accurate. The website showed 3-5 business days. I reached out to customer service and received no response. I waited another few days before doing an online chat and got an update; that the item was suspected to ship by the end of the week. I'm still waiting for it but the communication was bad and the lead times are really misleading.

September 5, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Sep 20, 2023

Hi Davey,

We thank you for reaching out. We see one of our agents has reached out and provided updates on your order. This will be ready to be delivered today. We thank you for your patience as we are working on getting our orders fulfilled in a timely matter. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
